Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Dave discovers he didn't graduate from high school and ends up in class with Alvin in 'Back to School', then in 'Bromance', Simon has found a new best friend, but then gets ditched.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds in 'Jeanette's Secret Garden', then in 'Treasure Hunt', the Chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him in 'Alvin's Wild Weekend', then in 'For Whom the Bell Tolls', a hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending in 'Munk Man', and in 'Ride Along', when Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety in 'The Karate Kidder', then in 'Playing Favourites', Alvin and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race.
